post.description: Queues a license creation on the License Server and returns immediately with `status = issuing`. Poll `GET /admin/license/issuances/{issuance_id}` or list the issuances to pick up `license_key` and `organization_token` once the worker stores the License Server document.

LicenseIssuanceStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a Portal -> LS license request.

``ISSUING`` means a worker has claimed the row and is calling the License
Server; ``ISSUED`` means the LS document has been stored. Both are what the
admin endpoint returns synchronously, so the client is never blocked on LS.
LicenseIssuanceStatus.title: LicenseIssuanceStatus

IssuanceOut.description:
Returned synchronously by the issuance endpoints.

``status`` is ``issuing``/``pending`` at call time; the license document
arrives later and is reflected here once a worker stores it.
IssuanceOut.title: IssuanceOut
